# Evaluate Once

Source: [4788](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4788); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Evaluate Once](../../api/values/evaluate-once.md).

<a id="wiki-4788-n1"></a>

- Evaluate Once freezes a subexpression's first value per action/condition while surrounding expression continues reevaluating.

<a id="wiki-4788-n2"></a>

- Use it on a for-loop offset inside reevaluated effect position to keep each effect's initial offset while following a player.

Source limitations:

- Input type printed as Void is suspicious; do not propagate as authoritative type constraint.
